summary: First full test iteration on SmartLife Zoning Gainable app. Backend: all 12 pytest tests pass covering /api/system (GET/PUT valid+invalid mode), /api/zones (list+update+404), /api/devices (list+sync), /api/simulate/tick, and /api/schedule (CRUD + 404 cases). Frontend: full UI walkthrough via Playwright verifying master thermostat (mode chaud/froid, power, +/- setpoint, fan speeds), 6 zone cards with working +/-/toggle, tabs (zones/devices/schedule) switching, devices sync button, schedule add/delete slot flow. All flows work with real backend integration. Design is clean and consistent; no contrast/spacing issues observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Dialog missing aria-describedby (a11y warning in console). Non-blocking but should add DialogDescription for accessibility.
PUT /api/schedule/{id} uses ScheduleSlotCreate as payload but also overwrites id via $set of payload.model_dump() - safe currently since 'id' not in ScheduleSlotCreate. Fine.
seed_data runs on startup and inserts random battery/signal - deterministic seeding would help testing but acceptable for mocked data.
CORS allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' is unusual but functional; consider restricting in production.
startup/shutdown event decorators are deprecated in FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 1 system doc, 6 zones, 7 devices (1 gainable + 6 thermostats) on startup. No additional test seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All endpoints and UI flows verified. Test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is reusable regression suite. Frontend polls /api/simulate/tick every 4s; temperatures fluctuate between checks - avoid asserting exact temp values in future tests.
